test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of ₹5,575 is invested at the rate of 8% simple interest per annum for 4 years. What will be the interest (in ₹) payable on maturity?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹5,575

Rate of Interest (R) = 8% per annum

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / (100)

**Calculation:**

Principal (P) = 5,575

Rate of Interest (R) = 8%

Time (T) = 4 years

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / (100)

⇒ SI = (5,575 × 8 × 4) / (100)

⇒ SI = (5,575 × 32) / (100)

⇒ SI = (178,400) / (100)

⇒ SI = 1,784

**The interest payable on maturity is ₹1,784.**
